{{Quote|The Sulfur Lake Pirates aren't the brightest pirate band on Lok. First, they named themselves after the lake where they have their 'hidden' lair. When they realized that every other group on Lok knew where they were holed up, the Sulfur crew hired me to set up some defenses.|[[Choster]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:SwC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Speak with Choster|Lok}}</ref>}}
The '''Sulfur Lake''' was a vast [[Sulfur/Legends|sulfur]] pool on the desert [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lok/Legends|Lok]]. It was located between the [[Sulphur Hills]] and the [[Westerly]] regions.<ref name="SWG" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Sulfur Lake Pirates]] named themselves after the lake because their secret [[Sulfur Lake Pirate Hideout|hideout]] was located nearby. Indeed, they unintentionally revealed the location of their hideout to their rivals.<ref name="SWG:SwC" /> After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] briefly resided in a [[Rebel outpost (Lok)|house]] built on a small island in the middle of the lake.<ref name="SWG:CoA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sulfur Lake appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
